entries.summary: Chat gets an answer style picker (Balanced, Teacher, Code only, Reviewer, Rubber duck), an answer length picker, quick prompt chips, and Regenerate / Copy / Export buttons in the options fold. Settings is grouped into Chat, Editor and Interface, and gains custom instructions for every chat, a history window, a send-key choice, a completion ping toggle, message time stamps, an editor font picker, compact chat and reduce motion.

The Context lab gains an Export section: the current slice is exported by GhostSlice itself into a bundle, then converted by the GhostConvert tool into AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, Copilot instructions, or a generic prompt - with every conversion loss named per format from the tool's own LOSSES.md, and the output verified by the tool before it is shown.
